description: Mail storage statistics for a hosting service. Supply `domain` to scope the figures to one domain; omit it for the whole service.

domain.description: Restrict the statistics to this domain. Omit for the whole hosting service.

hostingId.description: Hosting id or uuid the mailbox belongs to.

userId.description: Account id, or the literal "self" for the authenticated account. Defaults to "self".

name: ws_mail_stats
title: Mail statistics
